connector.name: Eur Lex MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Search EU legislation, CJEU case law, and treaties; traverse CELLAR graph; browse EuroVoc concepts.
connector.summary: Hosted at eur-lex.caseyjhand.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package eur-lex-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cyanheads account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
